title: Page art from CDN URLs with local fallback

outcome: The page loads its art only from packages/page/assets, and the local PNGs are tracked by git.
Every image slot the page uses has one place to set a CDN URL, and a slot left empty uses the local file.
forbid: no build step, bundler or env loader added — the page stays plain tsc output served by the engine

outcome: An image the CDN cannot serve with CORS falls back to the local file, then to the built-in art.
Local PNGs in packages/page/assets are ignored by git while staying on disk as the fallback.
Invariant 5 allows the page to load art from CDN URLs the developer configures, and nothing else leaves localhost.

evidence: packages/page/src/art-urls.ts holds one URL per slot (map, soldier, unit, portrait); AssetName is derived from it, so the loader cannot use an unregistered slot; art-urls test checks the list and that an empty slot uses /assets/<slot>.png

headless Chrome with map=https://cdn.invalid/... logged the fallback warning and loaded /assets/map.png; soldier from a CORS server on :4800 loaded and getImageData on it succeeded (recolouring works)
.gitignore ignores packages/page/assets/*.png and assets/source/; git status shows only assets/README.md; the files stay on disk and :4747 still serves /assets/map.png (200)
Invariant 5 edited in place: outbound traffic is the card-writer LLM plus image GETs to the CDN URLs set in art-urls.ts

disposition: Shipped: art-urls.ts registry (CDN URL -> local assets/<slot>.png -> built-in art) with CORS-aware loading and a console warning on fallback; local PNGs git-ignored; Invariant 5 updated.
